senses.gloss:
उद्धन् €2 P. [उद्-हन्] To raise up, elevate (fig. also) Rv. 10. 102. 7.
 Ā. To kill oneʼs self; Rām.; Pt. see उद्धत.

उद्धत p. p.
—1 Raised up, elevated, lifted up; लाङ्गूलमुद्धतं धुन्वन् Bk. 9. 7;
 आत्मोद्धतैरपि रजोभिः Ś. 1. 8 raised; खुर˚ R. 9. 50, heaved; Ki. 8. 53.
—2 Excessive, very much, exceeding.
—3 Haughty, vain, puffed up; प्रहितो रावणेनैष सह वीरैर्मदोद्धतैः
 Rām. 5. 58. 130. अक्षवधोद्धतः R. 12. 63.
—4 Harsh; वचनै रसतां महीयसो न खलु व्येति गुरुत्वमुद्धतैः Śi. 16. 27.
—5 Excited, inflamed, intensified; ˚मनोभवरागा Ki. 9. 68, 69; मदोद्धताः
 प्रत्यनिलं विचेरुः Ku. 3. 31,
—6 Majestic, stately; ill-mannered.
—7 Abounding in, full; ततस्तु धारोद्धतमेघकल्पम् Rām. 6. 67. 142.
—8 Eager, ready; युद्धोद्धतकृतोत्साहः संग्रामं सम्प्रपद्यत Rām. 5. 48. 16.
—9 Shining, glittering; अन्योन्यं रजसा तेन कौशेयोद्धतपाण्डुना Rām. 6. 55. 19.

उद्धत + .{@-तः@} A kingʼs wrestler.
.━{@Comp.@}: उद्धतमनस्, उद्धतमनस्क
उद्धत + -मनस्, -मनस्क a. high-minded, haughty, proud, ˚त्वम् Pride.
उद्धत + -मनस्, -मनस्क a. high-minded, haughty, proud, ˚त्वम् Pride.

उद्धतिः f.
—1 Elevation.
—2 Pride, haughtiness; नैवोद्धतिमाजगाम Śi. 3. 28.
—3 Rudeness, insolence; नयति द्रुतमुद्धतिश्रितः 16. 72.
—4 A stroke, shaking.
उद्धम See under उद्ध्मा.
उद्धम a. [उद्-ध्मा-श] Sounding, blowing.

उद्धर, -उद्धार
 See under उद्धृ.

उद्धर, -उद्धार
 See under उद्धृ.
उद्धारः + .{@-रा@} The plant गुडूची.

उद्धर्ष a. Delighted, glad; पतिमागतमाकर्ण्य पत्न्युद्धर्षाऽतिसम्भ्रमा
 Bhāg. 10. 81. 25.

उद्धर्ष + .{@-र्षः@}
—1 Great joy or delight.
—2 Courage or energy to undertake a thing; अमर्षजनितोद्धर्षाश्चकुः
 कर्माण्यभीतवत् Rām. 6. 52. 6.
—3 A festival (especially a religious one).
—4 Excess, abundance; (उद्रेक); आपूर्यत बलोद्धर्षैर्वायुवेगैरिवार्णवः
 Rām. 6. 74. 35.

उद्धर्षण a. Animating, encouraging, exciting; हितमुद्धर्षणं
 चैव उवाच प्रथितं वचः Rām. निदर्शनान्युपायांश्च बहून्युद्धर्षणानि
 च Mb. 5. 135. 32.

उद्धर्षिन् a.
—1 Encouraging.
—2 (Ved.) One whose hair is erect.

—1 A sacrificial fire.
—2 A festival, holiday.
—3 N. of a Yādava, uncle and friend of Kṛṣṇa. [When Kṛṣṇa was
 taken by Akrūra to Maṭhurā, Uddhava was implored by the citizens of
 Gokula to go and fetch him. He was very much attached to Kṛṣṇa. On
 seeing the destruction of the Yādavas to be inevitable, he went to Kṛṣṇa
 and asked him what to do; whereupon he was told to go to Badarikāśrama
 to practise penance and to secure heaven. He is the subject of two short
 poems, उद्धवदूत and उद्धवसंदेश.]
उद्धस्त a. Extending or raising the hands.

उद्धा I. €3 P. Ved.
—1 To abandon or expose (an infant).
—2 To set up, erect, build. ━II. €3 Ā.
—1 To go or move upwards, rise (as the sun, dust &c.); यतो रजः पार्थिवमुज्जिहीते
 R. 13. 64; Mu. 4. 21; Bk. 18. 27; N. 22. 45, 55.
—2 To go away from, depart; उज्जिहानजीविताम् Māl. 10.
—3 To raise; शिरसा यूपमुज्जिहीते Kāty.
—4 To throw up, knit (as eyebrows); सौमित्रिरक्षिभ्रुवमुज्जिहानः Bk. 3. 47.

उद्धान a.
—1 Ejected, vomited.
—2 Inflated, corpulent, fat.
—3 Gone up, ascended, risen.

उद्धान + .{@-नम्@}
—1 A fireplace.
—2 Ejecting, vomiting.
—3 Abandonment, leaving.

उद्धिः [उद्-धा-कि] उपसर्गे धोः किः P. III. 3. 92. Ved.
—1 A particular part of a carriage (the part which rests on the axles).
—2 An earthen stand on which the Ukhā rests.
उद्धित p. p. Set up, erected.
उद्धान्त a. Ejected, vomited.
उद्धान्त + .{@-तः@} An elephant out of rut (from whose temples ichor ceases to flow).

उद्धुर a. [उद्गता धूरस्मात्]
—1 Freed from a burden or yoke, unrestrained, unchecked, free. cf.
 सैन्धवाः समरोद्धुराः Śiva B. 9. 65; also सङ्गरोद्धुराः ibid. 25. 19.
—2 Firm, intrepid, bold; अभियोग˚ Mv. 6.
—3 Victorious, conquering.
—4 High, loud (voice &c.); पितरमुद्धुरध्वनिमहाजनानुयातमानीय Dk. 104.
—5 Heavy, full of; जग्मे जयोद्धुरविशालविषाणमुक्ष्णा Śi. 5. 64.
—6 Thick, gross.
—7 Lively, cheerful.
—8 Able, competent; मृद्वीकामधुमाधुरीमदपरीहारोद्धुराणां गिराम् Bv. 4. 40.

उद्धू €5. €9. U.
—1 To shake, move up, raise, throw up, wave (as a chawari); कैर्नोद्धूतानि
 चामराणि K. 117, 200; Ku. 2. 29; उद्धूनीयात सत्केतून् Bk. 19. 8; Ki. 5. 39.
—2 To shake or throw off; संमार्जन्यो नूनमुद्धूयमाना भान्ति स्मोच्चैः
 केतनानां पताकाः Śi. 18. 8 dispel, destroy (fig.); उद्धूतपापाः Me. 57.
—6 To disturb, excite, rouse up.

उद्धूत p. p.
—1 Shaken off, fallen from; raised or thrown up; मारुतभरोद्धूतोऽपि
 धूलिव्रजः Dhan. V.
—2 Exalted, high, loud.
—3 Ruffled, tossed up; उद्धूतमिव सागरम् Mb. 5. 193. 4.
—4 Blossomed, cheerful; आसीद्वनमिवोद्धूत स्त्रीवनं रावणस्य तत् Rām. 5. 9. 66.
—5 High, gone up (उन्नत); देवदारुभिरुद्धूतैरूर्ध्वबाहुमिव स्थितम्
 Rām. 5. 56. 29.

उद्धूत + .{@-तम्@}
—1 Stamping.
—2 Throwing up.
—3 Turning up; digging.

—1 Throwing upwards, raising.
—2 Shaking.
उद्धूपनम् Fumigating.

—1 Powdering, sprinkling with dust or powder; भस्मोद्धूलन भद्रमस्तु
 भवने K. P. 10; K. 129.
—2 An article used to season food.
उद्धूलयति Den. P. To powder, sprinkle with powder or dust.
उद्धूषणम् Erection of the hair (on the body), thrill, horripilation.
उद्धृषित a. Having the hairs erect (through joy); Pt. 1.

उद्धृ I. €1. €10 P.
—1 To draw out, raise up. —2 To save, deliver; भगवति तव स्पृष्टानद्भिश्चिरादुददीधरत्
 U. 1. 23. ━II. [उद्-हृ] —1 To draw or take out, extract, extricate; शरं
 … उद्धर्तुमैच्छत् R. 2. 30, 3. 64; to deliver from, relieve of, save,
 rescue, protect (with abl.); मां तावदुद्धर शुचो दयिताप्रवृत्त्या
 V. 4. 31; Pt. 1. 358; Bg. 6. 5.
—2 To uproot, extirpate, eradicate; tear or pull out; नमयामास नृपाननुद्धरन्
 R. 8. 9, 4. 66; त्रिदिवमुद्धृतदानवकण्टकम् Ś. 7. 3; Mv. 3. 13;
 Māl. 9. 22; उद्धरणीये चक्षुषी Dk. 102.
—3 To pluck up (flowers &c.); K. 21, 144.
—4 To raise, lift up, elevate, extend (as hands); पातयितुमेव शक्तिर्नान्नपिटमुद्धर्तुम्
 Pt. 1. 363; Ms. 4. 62; V. 4. 34.
—5 To take up, absorb (water); उद्धरिष्यन्रसानिव R. 4. 66; उद्धृत्य
 मेघैस्तत एव तोयम् Śi. 3. 75.
—6 To sustain, bear up; राज्यधुरमुद्धर्तुम् Pt. 1.
—7 To separate, abstract.
—8 To remove, put away.
—9 To deduct, subtract. विट्पण्यमुद्धृतोद्धारं विकेयं वित्तवर्धनम् Ms. 10. 85.
—10 To select, pick out; एवं समुद्धतोद्धारे समानंशान्प्रकल्पयेत् Ms. 9. 116.
—11 To present,
[]
 offer; Y. 1. 159.
—12 To prove; आगमस्तु कृतो येन सोऽभियुक्तस्तमुद्धरेत् Y. 2. 28.
—13 To divide (as with partners).
—14 To publish, make known.
—15 To undo, destroy; एष त्वां सजनामात्यमुद्धरामि स्थिरो भव Mb. 5. 189. 23.
━Caus. To cause to extract or draw out; शल्यं
 निखातमुदहारयतामुरस्तः R. 9. 78.

—1 Drawing or taking out, taking off (clothes &c.).
—2 Extraction, pulling or tearing out; कण्टक˚ Ms. 9. 252; चक्षुषोरुद्धरणम्
 Mit.; so शल्य˚.
—3 Extricating, deliverance, rescuing (from danger); दीनोद्धरणोचितस्य
 R. 2. 25; स बन्धुर्यो विपन्नानामापदुद्धरणक्षमः H. 1. 29.
—4 Destruction, eradication, extermination, deposition, dethronement;
 चन्द्रगुप्तस्योद्धरणात् Mu. 4.
—5 Lifting, raising.
—6 Taking a part or share.
—7 Taking from the Gārhapatya fire to supply the other sacred fires.
—8 Vomiting; जग्धस्य मोहाद्धि विशुद्धिमन्धसो जुगुप्सितस्योद्धरणं प्रचक्षते
 Bhāg. 4. 4. 18.
—9 Anything vomited.
—10 Final emancipation.
—11 Acquittance of debt.
—12 Hoping, expecting; अपि ते ब्राह्मणा भुक्त्वा गताः सोद्धरणान् गृहान्
 Mb. 13. 60. 14.

—1 Raising, elevating.
—2 Rescuing, drawing out of (danger), delivering.
—3 Sharing, dividing.

उद्धर्तृ, उद्धारक a.
—1 One who raises or lifts up.
—2 A sharer, co-heir.
—3 One who recovers property. ━m.
—1 A destroyer, exterminator; Y. 2. 271.
—2 A saviour, deliverer.

उद्धर्तृ, उद्धारक a.
—1 One who raises or lifts up.
—2 A sharer, co-heir.
—3 One who recovers property. ━m.
—1 A destroyer, exterminator; Y. 2. 271.
—2 A saviour, deliverer.
उद्धारकविधिः m. Mode of giving or paying; तत्कथय कथमस्योद्धारकविधिर्भविष्यति Pt. 2.

—1 Drawing out, extraction.
—2 Deliverance, redemption, saving, rescuing, extrication.
—3 Raising, lifting up.
—4 Deduction, a part to be set aside.
—5 (In law) A part to be set aside from the paternal property for the
 benefit of the eldest son; the surplus allowed by law to the eldest beyond
 the shares of the younger brothers; ज्येष्ठस्य विंश उद्धारः सर्वद्रव्याच्च
 यद्वरम् Ms. 9. 112.
—6 The sixth part of booty taken in war which belongs to the king; राज्ञश्च
 दद्युरुद्धारमित्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः Ms. 7. 97.
—7 An obligation.
—8 Debt, particularly such as bears no interest.
—9 Recovering property.
—10 Marching out.
—11 Citing (a passage), quoting.
—12 Final beatitude.
—13 Prosperity, elevation.
—14 Compilation.
—15 Leavings of dishes.

उद्धारः + .{@-रम्@} A fire-place.
.━{@Comp.@}: उद्धारकोशः, उद्धारविभागः
उद्धारः + -कोशः N. of a work.
उद्धारः + -विभागः Division of shares, partition.
उद्धारित a. Taken out, drawn forth, extricated, released.

उद्धृत p. p.
—1 Drawn up or out (water), extracted &c.
—2 Raised, elevated, lifted up, thrown up or upwards; निक्षेपणाय पदमुद्धृतमुद्वहन्ती Ku. 5. 85.
—3 Uprooted, eradicated; उद्धृतारिः R. 2. 30.
—4 Separated, set
[]
 apart.
—5 Divided, partitioned; ऋग्यजुःसामाथर्वाख्या वेदाश्वत्वार उद्धृताः
 Bhāg. 1. 4. 20.
—6 Selected.
—7 Dispersed, scattered.
—8 Holding, containing.
—9 Uncovered.
—10 Vomited, cast up.
.━{@Comp.@}: उद्धृतोद्धार, उद्धृतस्नेह

उद्धृत + -उद्धार a.
—1 one who has received his share of the patrimony.
—2 that from which the proper part has been deducted; Ms. 10. 85.
उद्धृत + -स्नेह a. skimmed (as milk); न भुञ्जीतोद्धृतस्नेहम् Ms. 4. 62.

उद्धृतिः f.
—1 Drawing or pulling out, extracting.
—2 An extract, passage selected.
—3 Delivering, rescuing.
—4 Especially, delivering or purifying from sin, final liberation; त्रपन्ते
 तीर्थानि त्वरितमिह यस्योद्धृतिविधौ G. L. 28.

उद्ध्मा €1 P.
—1 To breathe out, puff, blow.
—2 To inflate, to make known by blowing (a trumpet).
उद्ध्मानम् A fire-place, stove.

उद्ध्यः [P. III. 1. 115; cf. उज्झत्युदकमिति उद्ध्यः Malli.] N.
 of a river; तोयदागम इवोद्ध्यभिद्ययोः R. 11. 8.
उद्ध्वंसः Hoarseness (of sound).
